notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42039887/2f7a94f0c861d9b4292d09bbf19de7ffb8d2d5a7.png[/img]
[h1]Crumbling gets its first update v1.0.12[/h1]

A few weeks after releasing the Crumblings into the wild, we have made a few changes and fixes with this update. Most importantly, this update comes with thumbstick locomotion and some quality-of-life improvements.

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]Thumbstick locomotion. You can configure step-wise and continuous in the menu.
[*]Skip mini games.
[*]Stars for your performance when beating a boss.
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Spiky balls now have way cooler movement. You can swing them at your foes by moving around.
[*]'Missing Page' text in comics is now localized.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]The spiky ball doesn't deal infinite damage anymore when it has the burn-upgrade (whoopsie).
[*]Fixed some toys in the store that couldn't be grabbed.
[*]Narrator slider shows correct volume.
[*]Controller vibration targets whatever hand you are wielding the Crumbling with.
[*]Hands disappear when closing the in-game menu using the menu button.
[*]Scale setting is now saved.
[*]Confident & Berserk collectible aura sound stops again and isn't as loud.
[*]Shaman projectile totems aim at the Golem heart.
[*]No comic page popping up after defeating a boss a second time.
[/list]
[h2]What's next?![/h2]
We are currently working on multiple things in parallel. More Crumblings and theme worlds are in the making. So stay tuned!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42039887/d4d75a8e9a787754344217b9ff5169b39d59df80.png[/img]

If you want to participate and suggest cool new content & features, chat with us on Discord https://discord.gg/k3PPEQ54W6

notes.title: Crumbling OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=G2fFnKbXoyI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Crumbling is out now![/h1]

Heya fellow Crumblings!

Wow, this is beyond exciting! After so many years my little Crumblings are finally released into the wild. But I am sure they are in good hands! Are you ready to unpack your Crumbling and go into battle against the evil hordes of monster toys?

I think it was five years ago when I doodled the first sketches and wrote the first lines of code. I had this idea that VR desperately needed some third-person games. Back then there weren't many around and I think there still are none that are quite like Crumbling. 

I wouldn't have imagined the journey this game would take. I found many great artists, musicians and fellow game developers that joined me on this adventure and built this game. It feels incredibly strange to finally release it and have all of you try out this quirky adventure. I hope you like it, I really do!

I want to thank all the amazing people that worked with me on this and all the lovely players and their invaluable feedback. It couldn't have been done without you. And now get your Crumbling out of that box and fight, fight fight!

Cheers,
Ole

notes.title: Crumbling - Adding new features!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Crumblings! 

It’s been a busy month here at Crumble's Crafts and Comics. We’ve been working on adding some new features such as the world mini games, and experimenting with shiny new moves for the Crumblings.

Take a look at the new Hot Wire mini game for The Hills diorama world, guaranteed to only be capable of hurting your pride!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42039887/a7d4a15026b9a1e1f3a97fd73c9dd1bb1359131e.gif[/img]

And for the Crumblings, an experimental smash attack and dash evade!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42039887/014e1c9d43dcc31f07dc410b49ddb80ad3e44f1f.gif[/img]

We’ll keep you up to date as we implement more fun things, and if you’d like to be a part of the conversation you can [url=https://discord.gg/DY6tSdxKCr]join us on Discord[/url] where we have forums for new features. And if you haven’t already, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1701870/Crumbling/]don’t forget to wishlist Crumbling[/url]. It helps out more than you know!

Best,

notes.title: Crumbling - Let’s talk heroes!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Crumblings!

Whilst we’re busy working away Crumbling, we wanted to take today to introduce you to our heroes. These cute but fierce action figurines are the main characters of the game. Made with a secret magic ingredient that brings them to life, you’ll take control of them to battle the evil Bose Corp.

There’s three different Crumblings to choose from; [b]The Knight,[/b] [b]The Blaster[/b] and [b]The Shaman.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42039887/054053572ff3900d947cbd07a12ba21966f3bf54.gif[/img]

Each hero has their own basic attack, dodge and a special attack for when you really want to pack a punch! From the triple slash of the Knight or the magical pew pew of the Shaman, we’re certain you’ll find a favourite. 

If you’d like to try out a hero in action [url=https://ocul.us/3IG17BO]you can play the demo here![/url] We’re also on [url=https://twitter.com/CrumblingVR]Twitter [/url]and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@crumblingvr]TikTok [/url]if you’d like to keep up to date with any news and announcements. 

And if you haven’t already, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1701870/Crumbling/]don’t forget to wishlist Crumbling[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/DY6tSdxKCr]join us on Discord[/url]. It helps out more than you know!

notes.title: New trailer, release window and more
notes.content:
Howdy fellow Crumbling,

It’s been a while! Hope you had a good start in the year!

We have been busy at work finishing Crumbling and just wanted to give you an update on what we are working on!

State of the game and release window

Mostly importantly, we have been working hard to finish the game! :D Development is going very well and Crumbling feels more and more like a full game. We’ve got quite some levels and loads of monsters in good shape but still have a while to go and, of course, still need to polish it. 

But with the current timelines in mind, we should be releasing Crumbling this year. We are crossing our fingers for a summer release for Steam and Quest 2. :) As soon as we know more about a firm date, we will let you know!

[b]New trailer![/b]

[previewyoutube=kDldjRKaATc;full][/previewyoutube]

We have also updated our current trailer since it has been out for a while! If you’ve followed Crumbling for some time, you will be able to spot the new shots. As we get closer to finishing and releasing the game, we also want to share behind-the-scenes looks at Crumbling in the coming weeks more regularly! :) 

Anyway, for now, here is the updated trailer.

That’s it for this week! :) Hope you liked our update. We will be back with more Crumbling news very soon!

Ole
